rationale: Biologically plausible and MISEV-aligned; the orthogonal intact‑EV attributes are appropriate to test as qualitative stability/comparability gates. However, testing must include pre‑qualified capture reagents across candidate buffers/devices, a validated exogenous intact‑EV spike‑in for within‑sample recovery, multi‑lot (≥3) reproducibility and assay‑sensitivity demonstration, and positive/compatibility controls to rule out excipient or device assay interference. A short‑interval in vivo recovery study would be needed later to link the in vitro signatures to recoverable exposure.
